body.statement: For every finite sample, \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj}}^{R}\) is positive definite, all block inverses in def:multiplier-ellipses exist, and the conditional critical value \(\widehat c_{1-\gamma}\) is well defined in \([0,\infty)\). Conditionally on the data, \(Z^\star\) consistently estimates the law of \(\sqrt{n/L_n}(\widehat\tau-\tau(P))\), and the ridged ellipses obey \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal F_s}\mathbb P_P\{\tau_j(P)\in\mathcal E_j\text{ for all }1\leq j\leq J\}\to1-\gamma\).
body.justification: Finite-sample ridge invertibility and the conditional Gaussian multiplier identity hold.
body.gap: Coverage still awaits both the joint critical limit and covariance consistency.
body.consumer: The ellipses remain a proposed procedure rather than a certified confidence construction.

obligation.what_is_open: Transfer an established joint critical limit and consistent covariance estimate through the conditional multiplier maximum.
obligation.obstruction: Both probabilistic parent results remain open, although the ridge and conditional Gaussian algebra are complete.
obligation.attempted: Finite-sample invertibility, the exact conditional multiplier covariance, and continuity of the limiting maximum law were checked.
obligation.partial_result:
For every sample, \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj}}^R=\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj}}+n^{-1}I_{2J}\) is positive definite.  Conditionally on the data, Gaussianity and independence of the multipliers give exactly
\[
Z^\star\mid\text{data}\sim N(0,\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj}}).
\]
If the joint critical limit and covariance consistency are established, the limiting maximum is the maximum of \(J\) independent \(\chi_2^2\) variables and has a continuous distribution, which yields the claimed conditional quantile convergence.  Those two parent convergence results remain open.
